# Session handoff: YYYY-MM-DD

Copy this into the pull request description (or `docs/status/STATUS.md` "Last session" section) at the end of every
working session, human or agent. The next session must be able to continue from this alone.

## What was done
- (each item: what changed, where, and the commit or PR)

## What was verified
- Commands run and their results (tests, lint, manual checks). If something was **not** verified, say so.

## Decisions made
- (each: the decision, and the ADR that records it; "none" is a valid answer)

## Open items and risks
- (anything half-done, any known defect, anything that surprised us)

## Exact next step
- The single most useful thing to do next, specific enough to start without asking.

## Docs updated
- [ ] `docs/status/STATUS.md`
- [ ] ADR added or status changed (if a decision was made)
- [ ] Requirements or roadmap changed (if scope changed)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` (if user-visible)
